note: Private RV park (Watson) at the edge of the Percival Springs (2T2) turf airstrip off US-45, about 8 minutes from I-57; gravel pull-through spurs in grass take the longest rigs. Small on-site restaurant. A general drive-in RV park, not aviation-only: ultralights, paramotors and an EMS helicopter use the field by day, and flights toward the campground are banned. Some sites are kept for intermediate and long-term stays. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, about, rules, contact) + Google + imagery read. 24 full-hookup 30/50 A sites, pull-through, coin showers and laundry, open year round, booked by phone (217-994-6470; stored 217-536-9990). A real RV park beside a turf airstrip, not a parking lot. No posted rate; RV Life $$; one camper report of $40. Google 4.8/33.
flags: WHAT IT IS: a real RV campground, not an airport parking lot. Imagery shows its own gravel loop east of US-45 with ~14 angled gravel pull-through spurs (centre ~39.0154,-88.5427) plus a smaller southern loop, beside a 2,000 ft turf runway ('Our 24 site campground sits at the edge of Percival Springs [2T2] Airport'). Ultralight/paramotor flying happens on the showgrounds east of the campground; the rules ban flights toward the RV park.

PRICE GATE (private): no rate on the operator's site; booking is by phone only. RV Life tier $$ (stored price_tier 2). Camper report: a Google review 5 months ago gives '40.00' (not written to fees: the operator has its own page). No gateway within 40 km. Not in the Good Sam directory cache. Passes on the $$ tier; no evidence of a night over $50.
PRESENCE: working website with phone (217-994-6470) and Google Maps open, 4.8 stars from 33 reviews. Passes.

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) not seasonal-only (open year round, 'overnight pull-through sites'); (2) no posted nightly rate, but the park leads with overnight sites, so test 2 is not in play (README step 6); (3) nothing for sale; (4) nightly share: the ~14 pull-through spurs of 24 sites are the overnight row (~60%); 'Intermediate and long-term' sites exist; (5) no approval wording. Ordinary park: keep.
